# cato_permission_catalog (Data Source)

Reads resources and supported actions available for defining custom roles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cato_permission_catalog" "available" {
  # account_id = "123456"
}

output "grantable_resources" {
  value = data.cato_permission_catalog.available.resources
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) Account to query. Defaults to the provider account_id.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Account identifier for this query.
- `resources` (Attributes Set) Available permission resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `resource` (String) Permission resource identifier.
- `supported_actions` (Set of String) Actions grantable on this resource: VIEW or EDIT.
